utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I still haven’t heard a firm date, but after school sounds like the likely plan. People seem ready to help as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: After school is fine in theory, Rey, but I still need the storage spot and the one person handling missed drop-offs confirmed before I’m comfortable with it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense—I haven’t heard those two pieces confirmed yet either, but I’ll ask around and let you know if anything solid comes up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, it’s coming along nicely—we’ve already got a few lamps and toasters piled up, and I’ve got my tool kit here if we need to crack anything open.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s good, but can we confirm the secure storage spot first and get a firm yes on who’s handling missed drop-offs before we commit?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, that’s fair—let’s lock down the storage spot first, and I’ll check who can take missed drop-offs before we promise anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still no firm date yet, Jules, but the whole neighborhood sounds ready to pitch in the minute we hear one. I’ll keep asking around and send word straight over as soon as anything’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Tess — once you hear the date, I’ll help spread it fast and remind folks to bring their broken things by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, lovely—that’ll help a ton, Jules. I’ll keep my ears open and come right by the moment there’s anything solid.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we lock anything in, can you confirm roughly how many bikes and scooters we’re expecting, and whether someone qualified can safely handle that stroller brake?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling everyone the repair drive’s coming up, so folks should bring their broken stuff by and pitch in, but I don’t have firm numbers yet or anyone confirmed for that stroller brake.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that’s helpful, but I’d want those details nailed down before we commit; can you check with Faye on expected numbers and whether she’s got someone who can safely take the stroller brake?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you heard back from anyone who can cover intake or cleanup, or do we still need to ask around for two or three more?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Still asking around while I’m out—we should keep looking for two or three more, and I’m also reminding folks about the extension cords, work gloves, and a spare tarp.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—keep at intake first, then cleanup, and let me know the minute you get any names. Do you have anyone tentative yet, or is it still all maybes?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, I think Saturday was the plan, but I might be mixing it up too—maybe we should check with Mina before I turn up with the wrong tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sorry—I’m coming in late again, but let’s check with Mina and I’ll keep working on the simple repair list so we’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds smart—I’ll ping Mina about the timing, and if it is Saturday I can bring extension cords or work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still leaning after school since I can stay through pickup; right now it’s mostly bikes, a couple of scooters, and one stroller brake, with Amir on tools and Denise on check-in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds great, Faye—I’ll add your after-school slot and spread the word so a couple more neighbors can cover intake and cleanup around Amir and Denise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—if you hear of anyone comfortable checking that stroller brake safely, that’s the one piece I still want covered before I lock in a day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Uli, I’m still set to handle check-in and help organize volunteers; I just want to make sure Mina confirms the timing before we lock the repair drive in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, thank you. I’m trying to keep the pickups and sorting from getting crossed up, so once Mina confirms the time we can lock the rest in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Exactly—that’ll make it much easier to keep the flow clean, and once Mina confirms, I can help Rosa see whether we still need that extra cleanup person.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, let’s keep it simple: make a neat list of the repairs first, then bring it by and we’ll line them up one by one for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds solid, Eli. We’ve got six confirmed so far, but intake’s still the thinnest spot, so I’m still hoping to round up two or three more before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good start, Sam; keep the list neat and bring it by when you’ve got those last couple lined up. Then we’ll set a clear order for the drive and keep things moving simply.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, Cleo’s got supplies mostly covered except extension cords and work gloves, but I still haven’t heard who’s handling tool drop-off or where it goes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in at 3:15 for a pickup run and sorting after, but I haven’t heard tool drop-off details either—can you check with Faye or Uli?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I can ask around, but last I’ve heard second-hand, that tool drop-off piece is still the loose end. If Faye or Uli know who’s collecting and where, I’ll pass it right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that breakdown will help a lot, and just so we’re aligned, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. Once I finish the flow, let’s do that quick walk-through together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—Sunday at the community center, and I’ve noted extension cords, work gloves, and a spare tarp for check-in. Once your flow is ready, I’ll walk it with you so we can place volunteers where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal—that’s exactly the kind of detail that keeps things running smoothly, and I’m grateful you’re on top of it. I’ll send you the flow as soon as it’s ready so we can do our quick walk-through before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s still this weekend, probably Saturday, but I’d rather check with Mina before I send you the wrong day again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just check with Mina on the timing—meanwhile we’re mainly still short on extension cords and work gloves, and a spare tarp if one turns up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, extension cords, work gloves, and maybe a spare tarp—I’ll try to remember that when I check with Mina about Saturday and the timing.
